song.theme: wanting a place to belong, in a scene that builds every want at once

runners: Built it: the website bot builds every wish said aloud, and a BUILT counter goes up (15 bumps)
what is the simcluster: asked as a joke all night, answered at the close with two real posts
gm/gn: everyone says gm, nobody says gn, until the host finally does
the crow: norvid's creature, from a first sighting to circling the skyline to the credits
the E key: Press E to leave, a giant key that falls on the desk and is pressed to end the show
Larry always loses: a score of 61, four dollars, a museum case, hunted by a crow
six minutes: the time from a wish to its being built
the song recaps the night's builds: weather channel, museum, podcast with no name
